title: Your handwriting might be the last thing AI can't read
title_candidates: What happens when AI runs out of data to read
No piece of writing is safe from AI
The internet wasn't enough for AI
AI already read the whole internet. It wants more.
Your handwriting might be the last thing AI can't read
caption:
AI companies have already scraped most of the public internet, and the hunger for more data isn't slowing down.

As these systems grow more powerful, they need exponentially more text and images to learn from. Some researchers think we could hit 'peak data' within a few years, where there simply isn't enough new content online to feed the next generation of AI. When that happens, nothing is off limits. Not books, not letters, not even your grandma's handwritten diary.
